authority: Author-authored source questions frozen before generation; separate from the withheld parent acceptance exercise.

questions.question: Who may decide eligibility and quarantine release?
questions.expected: Registry remains the eligibility authority; repair provider cannot release a tool.

questions.question: Does a wait-list reserve inventory?
questions.expected: No; member wait-list/closure choice retains an unfilled request without a tool reservation.

questions.question: Can either preparation contribution alone make a reservation ready?
questions.expected: No; independent concurrent registry and condition contributions must match the selected member/tool and both permit readiness.

questions.question: What starts the minimum hold?
questions.expected: Actual confirmed notice delivery; absence retains pending-notification and cannot create assumed-time expiry.

questions.question: What completes collection?
questions.expected: Matching, terms and identified-tool receipt acceptance precede custody transfer, which precedes on-loan state.

questions.question: Does a member report or repair-completed notice establish recovery?
questions.expected: No; actual steward receipt, condition assessment and accountable release are required in their respective cases.

questions.question: When must availability be excluded?
questions.expected: Reserved, on loan, awaiting returned-tool assessment and quarantined identified tools are not available offers.

questions.question: Were absent sizing values or verification results invented?
questions.expected: No; unknown values remain unvalued and all verification cases remain planned.
